## Problem and result

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.
Link the issue or identify the direct maintainer request.

## Verification

Link the completed document under `docs/verification/`.
Use the [verification template](https://github.com/statewell/statewell/blob/main/docs/verification/TEMPLATE.md).
Summarize results and record failed or omitted checks.
Identify agent assistance in the verification document.

## Contribution requirements

- [ ] The change provides a clear benefit under [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/statewell/statewell/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The verification document contains repeatable steps and actual results.
- [ ] The relevant checks pass, and remaining limitations are recorded.
- [ ] I reviewed the changes and have the right to submit the contribution.
